data_notice: Synthetic use cases for a simulated UK life and protection insurer; illustrative only.

use_cases.name: Underwriting Evidence Summariser
use_cases.description: Summarises application disclosures and medical evidence into a structured summary with page citations for an underwriter, who makes every decision; it never sets terms, exclusions or premium.
use_cases.value_rationale: Reduces the time underwriters spend reading application packs and improves consistency in how evidence is presented.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Medium because it handles sensitive medical evidence, but it only summarises cited source material and the underwriter makes every decision.

use_cases.name: Automated Underwriting Acceptance with Premium Loadings
use_cases.description: Provides straight-through acceptance and premium loadings for lower-complexity individual life applications, with underwriting teams reviewing only referred cases.
use_cases.value_rationale: Cuts underwriting turnaround and manual effort on straightforward applications while supporting consistent pricing.
use_cases.risk_rationale: High because it accepts cover and sets customer premiums without individual review, so an error or an unexplained loading can directly affect a customer.

use_cases.name: Automated Decline of Life Applications from Medical Evidence
use_cases.description: Allows underwriting operations to decline individual life applications directly from medical evidence and application data, with no underwriter review or customer challenge step.
use_cases.value_rationale: Could reduce handling cost and decision time on applications that meet clear decline criteria.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Unacceptable because it denies cover automatically using sensitive medical evidence, with no human judgement, explanation or route to challenge the outcome.

use_cases.name: Underwriting Rules Guidance Assistant
use_cases.description: Retrieves and explains approved underwriting rule guidance for underwriters handling non-standard cases.
use_cases.value_rationale: Provides a small productivity gain by reducing the time spent searching rule manuals and internal guidance.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Low because it is a staff-facing advisory tool that cites approved guidance, and the underwriter decides every case.

use_cases.name: Policy-Admin Data Exception Agent
use_cases.description: Flags conflicting policy records, including benefit amount mismatches, lapsed policies still collecting premium, commission split errors and conflicting life-assured details after a platform migration, and recommends an evidence-backed correction for a policy data owner to approve without writing to the policy administration system.
use_cases.value_rationale: Reduces manual reconciliation effort and improves the reliability of policy records for operations teams.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Medium because conflicting policy records can affect benefits and premiums, but the agent only recommends corrections and a policy data owner approves every change.

use_cases.name: New Business Document Completeness Check
use_cases.description: Checks new business submissions for missing or inconsistent documents and routes exceptions to new business administrators.
use_cases.value_rationale: Reduces rework and handling time caused by incomplete submissions.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Low because it is a staff-facing administrative check with no customer decision, and an administrator resolves every exception.

use_cases.name: Policy Alteration Triage
use_cases.description: Classifies sum-assured and beneficiary-change requests, checks them against policy rules and routes incomplete or sensitive cases to a policy administrator.
use_cases.value_rationale: Speeds up routine alterations and reduces hand-offs while keeping policy records current.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Medium because beneficiary and sum-assured changes affect who receives a payment and need clear auditability, but an administrator approves every alteration.

use_cases.name: Closed-Book Legacy Policy Data Remediation
use_cases.description: Extracts and reconciles data from closed-book legacy policy files and proposes corrected records for a remediation team to validate.
use_cases.value_rationale: Improves the accuracy of legacy policy records and reduces manual effort in servicing a closed book.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Medium because poor-quality legacy data could produce incorrect policy records that affect benefits, but every proposed correction is validated before it is applied.

use_cases.name: Adviser Quote and Illustration Assistant
use_cases.description: Drafts quotes and illustrations from approved product and rate data for advisers to review and issue.
use_cases.value_rationale: Reduces adviser administration time and improves consistency in the quotes and illustrations prepared for customers.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Low because it drafts from approved rates and product data, and the adviser reviews and issues every quote.

use_cases.name: Group Scheme Quote and Renewal Pricing Support
use_cases.description: Combines scheme census, benefit and experience data to recommend renewal pricing for group life and disability schemes, with the group pricing actuary setting final terms.
use_cases.value_rationale: Improves pricing consistency and reduces actuarial preparation time across group scheme renewals.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Medium because pricing recommendations affect scheme premiums and employer decisions, but an actuary reviews the evidence and sets the final terms.

use_cases.name: Retention and Lapse Propensity Insight
use_cases.description: Ranks existing policies by lapse likelihood and highlights possible retention actions for servicing teams, with all customer contact decided by a retention specialist.
use_cases.value_rationale: Helps servicing teams focus retention effort on the policies most likely to lapse.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Medium because retention targeting can affect vulnerable customers and the drivers behind a prediction are not fully explainable, but a retention specialist decides whether and how to contact anyone.

use_cases.name: Annuity Payment and Existence-Check Exception Review
use_cases.description: Reviews annuity payment and existence-check exceptions, gathers supporting evidence and recommends whether to continue, pause or escalate a payment for an annuity operations specialist to approve.
use_cases.value_rationale: Reduces manual investigation time and helps prevent incorrect payments continuing unnoticed.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Medium because pausing an annuity payment can cause financial hardship for a vulnerable customer, but a specialist reviews the evidence and approves every outcome.

use_cases.name: Death and Income-Protection Claim Document Intake
use_cases.description: Extracts and categorises documents from death and income-protection claims, checks completeness and routes each claim to the right claims handler.
use_cases.value_rationale: Reduces claims handling time and improves consistency in how incoming evidence is organised.
use_cases.risk_rationale: Medium because claim documents contain sensitive health and bereavement information, and extraction errors could delay payment to a vulnerable customer, but a handler reviews every claim.

use_cases.name: Claims Fraud Indicator Scoring
use_cases.description: Ranks claims by fraud likelihood and determines which claims are paused for investigation, with investigators able to release payment after review.
use_cases.value_rationale: Focuses investigator effort on the claims with the strongest fraud indicators and reduces claims leakage.
use_cases.risk_rationale: High because a false indicator can delay a legitimate claim, the factors behind the ranking are difficult to explain to a customer, and the outcome can affect vulnerable claimants.
